messages:
Ivy: Quick creative sprint request for the upcoming benchmark webinar (May 22). We need a templated visual pack that can be reused across launch posts, emails, and gated assets. Deliverables: hero (1200x628), email header (600x200), 5 responsive web slices (640/960/1200), 4 social microcards, animated slide (SVG/Lottie), and a one-page gated PDF. Deadline: first comps Wed EOD.
Marco: I'll run art direction. Ask: do we want separate messaging A/B variants for PLG vs enterprise audiences?
Ivy: Yes. Two messaging lanes: PLG = "fast to ship, low cost"; Enterprise = "predictable throughput & SLA". Keep copy short (<=10 words) for microcards.
Ben: For the gated PDF, produce A4 + mobile-friendly 800x1200. Include a modular table component for cost rows so we can swap numbers easily. I'll provide the CSV of sample metrics by Tue.
Tessa: Animation notes: animated slide should show cost curve + latency bands; export as SVG and Lottie for the deck. Make sure the Lottie export is under 1MB. Also include PNG fallbacks.
legal-bot: Reminder: any benchmarking claims must include the footnote "Internal Redwood Inference testing; results may vary by workload." No competitor product names or logos. GDPR copy required on gated forms.
asset-bot: Brand kit: https://drive.redwood/brand/latest 1 color tokens, type scale, logo lockups. Auto-validate on export. Recommended hero safe zone = 48px.
Marco: Routing/CTAs: hero needs two buttons: [Register] (goes to /events?utm_source=web&utm_campaign=bench_may) and [Get benchmark] -> gated form that collects name, company, email, role. Add hidden field campaign_id=bench_may_22. For enterprise lane, add secondary CTA: [Talk to sales] -> opens calendly link.
Ben: Can we include a tiny snippet on the one-pager listing test config (model, seq len, GPU)? Keep it to one line per config. Tessa 1 can you design a compact grid?
Tessa: Yep, will make a 3-column compact grid. Also building light/dark safe variants and alt-text examples for each microcard. Contrast checks will be run.
Ivy: Localization: EN + DE + FR. I'll drop translated strings by Tue 3pm. Also need editable copy blocks in Figma so translators can swap easily.
Marco: Timeline: wireframes Mon 10am, first comps Wed EOD, animated slide Thurs AM for rehearsal. I'll post Figma link when frames are up.
legal-bot: Add footer line on the one-pager: "Results from internal testing on May 2026; contact support@redwood.com for test details."
Ivy: Perfect. Please keep file export names consistent: benchpack_may2026_hero.png etc. Drop final exports to marketing-exports/bench_may2026/. Thanks all! :rocket:
